items.source: Factory method to crate a new JsonWriter.ValueProcessor that applies the given action.
items.translation: 工厂方法用于创建一个新的JsonWriter.ValueProcessor，以应用给定的操作。

items.source: Add the a JsonWriter.ValueProcessor to be applied when the JSON is written.
items.translation: 添加一个JsonWriter.ValueProcessor，以便在写入 JSON 时应用。

items.source: Uses of JsonWriter.ValueProcessor in org.springframework.boot.json

Return a new processor from this one that only applies to member with values
that match the given predicate.
items.translation: 返回一个新的处理器，该处理器仅适用于成员值与给定谓词匹配的情况。

items.source:
Return a new processor from this one that only applied to members with the
given path.
items.translation: 返回一个新的处理器，该处理器仅应用于具有给定路径的成员。

items.source:
Return a new processor from this one that only applied to members that match
the given path predicate.
items.translation: 返回一个新的处理器，该处理器仅应用于匹配给定路径谓词的成员。

items.source:
Return a new processor from this one that only applied to members with the
given path (ignoring escape characters).
items.translation: 返回一个新的处理器，该处理器仅应用于具有给定路径的成员（忽略转义字符）。

items.source:
Return a new processor from this one that only applies to member with values of
the given type.
items.translation: 返回一个新的处理器，该处理器仅适用于具有给定类型值的成员。
